messages:
maria: Thinking about safer config rollouts: propose `reserve_ratio` (fraction of pool held for SLO-critical routes) + `ramp_strategy` (enum: instant, linear, sigmoid) on route config. Want quick feedback.
sam: Interesting. Why ramp_strategy instead of just `ramp_duration_s`?
maria: strategy gives us control over how traffic moves during ramp. duration + strategy together define curve. sigmoid helps avoid oscillation on noisy signals.
tanya: telemetry ask: we need a derived metric `reserve_utilization_pct` and an event when utilization crosses thresholds (50/80/95). Otherwise ops won't notice until latency spikes.
ops-bot: ack. Will emit `config.reserve.utilization` gauge and `config.reserve.threshold_crossed` events with route, threshold, current_pct, timestamp.
sam: compatibility: older clients ignore new fields. Server should default reserve_ratio=0. Also require that `ramp_strategy` only applies when reserve_ratio>0.
maria: agreed. UI: route detail should show a miniature simulator where owners can toggle p95 up/down and see projected reserve usage and fallback activations. Dry-run mode should create the same simulated events but not affect routing.
tanya: testing plan: perf to run a staged canary with synthetic p95 noise. Also add a chaos test where we flip strategy between linear and sigmoid to observe stability.
maria: rollout plan: opt-in on a per-service basis, default off. We'll ship server-side acceptance, dry-run, telemetry, then enable console exposure. PR will include schema, event shape, and UI mocks.
sam: one more: add `telemetry_sample_rate` so during initial rollout we don't double our metrics. Default 0.02.
maria: done. I'll open RFC and tag @ops-bot and @tanya for telemetry review. :eyes:
